purpose: Measure local aerodynamic force and torque derivatives with respect to body angular velocity at five archived measured original-STS atmospheric states.

qualification.note: All wrench values are hypothetical KSP simulations. The archived source telemetry explicitly records a shadow-gate bypass and cannot qualify the campaign.

farApiLookupEvidence: [LOG 01:57:42.804] [kRPC] 10/09/2026 01:57:42 - Info - Load API: FerramAerospaceResearch not found; skipping
provenance.inputStateSelection: Five distinct archived atmospheric measurements, each within 0.6 s of a predetermined anchor UT; Mach > 3, dynamic pressure > 1 kPa, thrust zero, and speedbrakes recorded stowed.
provenance.rateUnits: Input body angular velocity in rad/s; saved telemetry bodyPitchRate/bodyRollRate/bodyYawRate values are degrees/s and converted to rad/s before rotation into the non-rotating reference frame.
provenance.surfaceStateLimit: The live checkpoint exposes neutral control surfaces. Historical run-9 control-surface deflections and per-sample RCS state are unavailable, so the simulation does not replay historical actuation.
provenance.noFlightMutation: The probe uses only hypothetical arguments to simulate_aerodynamic_wrench_at. It does not call setters for UT, pause, position, velocity, rotation, controls, action groups, throttle, SAS, RCS, physics, or save state.

gridDefinition.derivativeTensorUnits: d(body torque N m)/d(body angular velocity rad/s)
gridDefinition.derivativeMethod: Centered finite difference about each archived measured body-rate vector, independently perturbing one body axis at a time.

rateDampingSummary.interpretation: The simulated aerodynamic yaw-rate-to-roll-torque derivative is repeatable across these measured-state anchors. It is separate from the zero-dynamic-pressure reaction-wheel pulse and cannot identify that pulse's actuator source or establish a qualified atmospheric control gain.
